//go:build kubeapiserver

// Copied into stackstate-agent pkg/collector/corechecks/cluster/topologycollectors
// by generate.sh; it runs the cluster-agent collectors over testdata/cluster.json.
package topologycollectors

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	configmock "github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/config/mock"
	"github.com/StackVista/stackstate-receiver-go-client/pkg/model/topology"
	appsV1 "k8s.io/api/apps/v1"
	batchV1 "k8s.io/api/batch/v1"
	batchV1B1 "k8s.io/api/batch/v1beta1"
	coreV1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	extensionsV1B "k8s.io/api/extensions/v1beta1"
	netV1 "k8s.io/api/networking/v1"
	storageV1 "k8s.io/api/storage/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/version"
)

type goldenClient struct{ raw map[string][]json.RawMessage }

func goldenList[T any](t *testing.T, c *goldenClient, kind string) []T {
	out := []T{}
	for _, raw := range c.raw[kind] {
		var typed T
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &typed); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out = append(out, typed)
	}
	return out
}

type goldenAPI struct {
	t *testing.T
	c *goldenClient
}

func (g goldenAPI) GetDaemonSets() ([]appsV1.DaemonSet, error) { return goldenList[appsV1.DaemonSet](g.t, g.c, "DaemonSet"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetReplicaSets() ([]appsV1.ReplicaSet, error) { return goldenList[appsV1.ReplicaSet](g.t, g.c, "ReplicaSet"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetDeployments() ([]appsV1.Deployment, error) { return goldenList[appsV1.Deployment](g.t, g.c, "Deployment"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetStatefulSets() ([]appsV1.StatefulSet, error) { return goldenList[appsV1.StatefulSet](g.t, g.c, "StatefulSet"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetJobs() ([]batchV1.Job, error)                { return goldenList[batchV1.Job](g.t, g.c, "Job"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetCronJobsV1B1() ([]batchV1B1.CronJob, error)  { return nil, nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetCronJobsV1() ([]batchV1.CronJob, error)      { return goldenList[batchV1.CronJob](g.t, g.c, "CronJob"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetEndpoints() ([]coreV1.Endpoints, error)      { return goldenList[coreV1.Endpoints](g.t, g.c, "Endpoints"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetNodes() ([]coreV1.Node, error)               { return goldenList[coreV1.Node](g.t, g.c, "Node"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetPods() ([]coreV1.Pod, error)                 { return goldenList[coreV1.Pod](g.t, g.c, "Pod"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetServices() ([]coreV1.Service, error)         { return goldenList[coreV1.Service](g.t, g.c, "Service"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetIngressesExtV1B1() ([]extensionsV1B.Ingress, error) { return nil, nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetIngressesNetV1() ([]netV1.Ingress, error)    { return goldenList[netV1.Ingress](g.t, g.c, "Ingress"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetConfigMaps() ([]coreV1.ConfigMap, error)     { return goldenList[coreV1.ConfigMap](g.t, g.c, "ConfigMap"), nil }
func (g goldenAPI) GetSecrets() ([]coreV1.Secret, error)           { return goldenList[coreV1.Secret](g.t, g.c, "Secret"), nil }

	return goldenList[coreV1.PersistentVolume](g.t, g.c, "PersistentVolume"), nil

	return goldenList[coreV1.PersistentVolumeClaim](g.t, g.c, "PersistentVolumeClaim"), nil

}
func (g goldenAPI) GetVersion() (*version.Info, error) { return &version.Info{Major: "1", Minor: "33"}, nil }

func TestGenerateExporterGolden(t *testing.T) {
	fixture, output := os.Getenv("GOLDEN_FIXTURE"), os.Getenv("GOLDEN_OUTPUT")
	if fixture == "" || output == "" {
		t.Skip("GOLDEN_FIXTURE and GOLDEN_OUTPUT are required")
	}
	configmock.New(t).SetWithoutSource("cluster_name", "golden-cluster")

	data, err := os.ReadFile(fixture)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var objects []json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &objects); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	client := &goldenClient{raw: map[string][]json.RawMessage{}}
	for _, raw := range objects {
		var head struct{ Kind string }
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &head); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		client.raw[head.Kind] = append(client.raw[head.Kind], raw)
	}
	api := goldenAPI{t: t, c: client}
	instance := topology.Instance{Type: "kubernetes", URL: "golden-cluster"}

	nodeCh := make(chan *NodeIdentifierCorrelation)
	containerCh := make(chan *ContainerCorrelation)
	volumeCh := make(chan *VolumeCorrelation)
	podCh := make(chan *PodLabelCorrelation)
	endpointCh := make(chan *ServiceSelectorCorrelation)
	componentCh := make(chan *topology.Component)
	relationCh := make(chan *topology.Relation)

	k8sVersion, _ := api.GetVersion()
	common := NewClusterTopologyCommon(instance, Kubernetes, api, componentCh, relationCh, k8sVersion)
	collector := NewClusterTopologyCollector(common)
	collectors := []ClusterTopologyCollector{
		NewClusterCollector(collector),
		NewNodeCollector(nodeCh, collector),
		NewPodCollector(containerCh, volumeCh, podCh, collector),
		NewServiceCollector(endpointCh, collector),
		NewPersistentVolumeCollector(collector, false),
		NewNamespaceCollector(collector),
		NewConfigMapCollector(collector, 100*1024),
		NewSecretCollector(collector),
		NewDaemonSetCollector(collector),
		NewDeploymentCollector(collector),
		NewReplicaSetCollector(collector),
		NewStatefulSetCollector(collector),
		NewIngressCollector(collector),
		NewJobCollector(collector),
		NewCronJobCollector(collector),
	}
	correlator := NewClusterTopologyCorrelator(common)
	correlators := []ClusterTopologyCorrelator{
		NewContainerCorrelator(nodeCh, containerCh, correlator),
		NewVolumeCorrelator(volumeCh, correlator, true),
		NewService2PodCorrelator(podCh, endpointCh, correlator),
	}

	var producers sync.WaitGroup
	producers.Add(1 + len(correlators))
	go func() {
		defer producers.Done()
		for _, c := range collectors {
			if err := c.CollectorFunction(); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		}
	}()
	for _, c := range correlators {
		go func(c ClusterTopologyCorrelator) {
			defer producers.Done()
			if err := c.CorrelateFunction(); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		}(c)
	}
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { producers.Wait(); common.CorrelateRelations(); close(done) }()

	var components []*topology.Component
	var relations []*topology.Relation
loop:
	for {
		select {
		case c := <-componentCh:
			components = append(components, c)
		case r := <-relationCh:
			relations = append(relations, r)
		case <-done:
			break loop
		}
	}

	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"components": sortedJSON(t, components),
		"relations":  sortedJSON(t, relations),
	}, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(output, append(out, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func sortedJSON[T any](t *testing.T, items []T) []json.RawMessage {
	out := make([]json.RawMessage, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		raw, err := json.Marshal(item)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out = append(out, raw)
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return string(out[i]) < string(out[j]) })
	return out
}
